dedupe_keys.name: la reina santiago monthly building permit statistics 2017 2023

description: Dirección de Obras Municipales, Municipalidad de La Reina, Chile publishes monthly statistics prepared by the municipal works directorate on building permits, minor works permits, preliminary projects and regularisation certificates under Law 20.898, published one dataset per year (2017 to 2023 on the portal). Coverage: the commune of La Reina in Santiago, Chile; yearly datasets from 2017 to 2023, the 2023 one last modified on 2024-02-27. Format and access: PDF, XLSX, downloadable without registration from the Chilean open data portal (datos.gob.cl); the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons Attribution; cost: free. Caveats: monthly files are Excel sheets with a PDF for some months and were not opened; the tables count permits, not list individual buildings. Simulation uses: building-activity time series for urban growth and housing-supply models at commune level. Related catalogue records: other layers and datasets of the same portal in this catalogue are contextual companions.
name: La Reina (Santiago): monthly building permit statistics, 2017-2023
notes: Round 2 piece 14 (no-public-data visits): round 1 marked the Chilean bodies "MINVU Observatorio Urbano (municipal planning)" and "IDE Chile (mapping agency)" as publishing no data; the national open data portal datos.gob.cl was read on 2026-09-29.
